ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio dominated by low-intensity black pixels (approx. 90%) with scattered high-intensity white punctate regions (approx. 10%) across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Fine-grained, high-contrast white mottling distributed globally across the black background, with specific dense clusters of white pixels on the distal ends of both lobes and along the lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by varied pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys isolated against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the central notch upward and outward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, diagonal linear disruptions of white pixels visible on the left lobe, intersecting the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular dark protrusions and clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of external biological attachments.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip contains a dense, elevated cluster of dark pixels creating a distinct jagged termination compared to the smoother leading edges.
